bug_semantics: CWE-521 weak password requirements on the admin user-creation page. An authenticated administrator posting Senha / Confirmação da senha to /novosga.users/new can create accounts whose password is only Length min:6 (PoC 123456). novosga/users-bundle UsuarioType adds a RepeatedType senha field with NotNull+Length min:6 and no complexity, blocklist, or NotCompromisedPassword check; DefaultController::add hashes and persists that value. The same min-6-only policy is also in ChangePasswordType, ProfileController, and InstallCommand. CVE.org state is PUBLISHED (not withdrawn/rejected).
flaw_origin: The min-6-only user-creation policy was first written in novosga/novosga commit 556dde92fb3e8db1039d4f75336ceef32faea784 (2012-12-03 init) at web/modules/sga/usuarios/UsuariosController.php preSave: empty/mismatch/ctype_alnum plus strlen($senha)<6, which still accepts 123456. Parent c79bf1fdbadda75ddf6a0b1d942cbd23e9651af5 is README-only and lacks that file. Later moves (verificaSenha into AcessoBusiness, Symfony UsuarioType, extract to users-bundle, Length min:6 restore) are refactors of the same mechanism, not a new BIC. A 2025 Copilot commit on users-bundle only changed username regex.

reasoning: Vulnerability-first: CVE-2025-11322/GHSA-xgr2-5837-hf48 is a live CWE-521 finding, not a withdrawn advisory. The sink is the v2 user-creation form shipped via novosga/users-bundle at /novosga.users/new: Senha/Confirmação da senha is accepted if it is non-null and at least six characters, so 123456 succeeds. That Length min:6 policy is the same mechanism first written in 2012 in UsuariosController::preSave. The BIC is 556dde92fb3e8db1039d4f75336ceef32faea784, the smallest public commit that added those lines; its parent is a README-only initial commit and the file is absent there. The 908-file init cannot be decomposed into finer public members, so it is a valid first-write BIC rather than a later squash of an AI commit. Subsequent history (AcessoBusiness::verificaSenha, the 2016 Symfony UsuarioType with empty then restored min-6 constraints, and the users-bundle extract) moved/refactored the same weak policy; none of those is the BIC. AI judgment is BIC-only: the 2012 commit object is human rogeriolino@gmail.com with no AI trailers. The 2025 Copilot users-bundle PR is a later username-regex change and is not inverted into the introducer. No fix SHA exists: GHSA patched versions are None, v2.2.13 did not bump a password-policy fix, and v2.3.x/HEAD still enforce only min-6 on user create.
remaining_gap: unpatched: no upstream password-policy fix in novosga/novosga through v2.3.2 or in users-bundle v2.2.1/v2.3.0/2.4.x-dev; potential_fix documented in unpatched.potential_fix.

unpatched.reason: GHSA-xgr2-5837-hf48 lists patched versions None; CVE.org remains PUBLISHED with vendor non-response. v2.2.13 keeps users-bundle v2.2.1 (Length min:6). v2.3.0/v2.3.2 and users-bundle 2.4.x-dev still constrain new-user senha with NotNull+Length min:6 only; ProfileController and InstallCommand still use strlen<6.

potential_fix.approach: On Novosga\UsersBundle\Form\UsuarioType (new-user RepeatedType senha) and ChangePasswordType, replace Length min:6-only with a strong policy (minimum length 8+, PasswordStrength or equivalent complexity, and NotCompromisedPassword / common-password blocklist including 123456). Enable framework.validation.not_compromised_password and apply the same checks in src/Controller/ProfileController.php and src/Command/InstallCommand.php before hashing.
potential_fix.rationale: The /novosga.users/new sink currently treats any 6-character string as valid, which is exactly the PoC. Enforcing complexity and a compromised/common-password check at the form constraints (and the other password-set paths) rejects 123456 and closes CWE-521 without changing the create-user route.
